settings.title: Toolkit Extension Settings
settings.quickOpenDesc: Show the draggable Toolkit floating ball on web pages (injected via Content Script)
settings.ballSnapDesc: Snap to the left/right edge after dragging; turn off to let the ball stay anywhere
settings.ballActionDesc: In-page drawer: opens the toolbox on the right of the page; Browser side panel: tries to open the native side panel (may be blocked by Chrome gesture restrictions and falls back to the drawer).
settings.themeDesc: Choose the color scheme: System / Light / Dark. Applied instantly.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the interface language: System / 中文 / English.
settings.fontScaleDesc: Adjust the text and control size across all interfaces for readability.
settings.toolboxDesc: Choose which tools appear in the toolbox tabs and their order.
settings.toolboxHint: Drag the handle to reorder (with sliding animation); toggling a switch hides that tool. Changes are saved instantly.

toast.nativeSidePanelFallback: Tried to open the browser's native side panel, but it was blocked by Chrome's gesture restriction; using the in-page drawer instead

preview.title: Toolkit Extension · Dev preview
preview.heroDesc: Below is the UI of each entry. After installing into Chrome, load the extension from the dist/ directory (chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked).
preview.popupTitle: Popup shown when clicking the toolbar icon
preview.sidePanelTitle: Toolbox page (shared by the native side panel and the in-page drawer)
preview.contentTitle: Floating ball and drawer injected into web pages
preview.contentNote: The real extension injects a draggable floating ball into every http(s) page: drag it to dock against the left or right edge of the screen; it half-hides when the mouse leaves and slides out fully on hover. Clicking the ball opens the toolbox drawer on the right side of the page by default (this is exactly what you see in the browser preview; in real Chrome you can switch to opening the native side panel in settings, and the side panel page can conversely open the drawer in the page). Click the floating ball at the middle right of the page to try it.
